name: YTL
recent: YTL Corporation Berhad 在截至2026年9月30日的季度录得营收102.5亿令吉，同比增长34.1%，净利3.686亿令吉，同比增长6.4%。公司近期多次因凭单转换和ESOS行使而发行新股。此外，公司澄清了关于其数据中心业务协助Nvidia芯片转运的报道。
notable: 公司公布2026财年第一季度业绩，营收同比增长34.1%至102.5亿令吉，净利同比增长6.4%至3.686亿令吉。
公司多次因凭单转换为普通股及ESOS行使而发行新股。
公司澄清其数据中心业务未协助Nvidia芯片转运给中国客户。
risks: 公司因凭单转换和ESOS行使持续发行新股，可能对每股盈利造成摊薄。
EPF 在近期多次申报其持股变动。
earnings: 截至2026年9月30日的季度，营收为102.5亿令吉，同比增长34.1%，环比增长16.2%；净利为3.686亿令吉，同比增长6.4%，环比增长12.5%；净利率为3.6%，低于去年同期的3.7%。

recent_en: YTL Corporation Berhad reported revenue of RM10.25 billion for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, up 34.1% year-on-year, with net profit of RM368.6 million, up 6.4% year-on-year. The company has recently issued new shares multiple times due to warrant conversions and ESOS exercises. It also denied a report that its data centre unit aided Nvidia chip transfers.
notable_en: The company announced 1Q FY2026 results with revenue up 34.1% YoY to RM10.25 billion and net profit up 6.4% YoY to RM368.6 million.
The company issued new shares multiple times due to conversion of warrants into ordinary shares and ESOS exercises.
The company clarified that its data centre unit did not aid Nvidia chip transfers to Chinese customers.
risks_en: The company continues to issue new shares from warrant conversions and ESOS exercises, which may dilute earnings per share.
EPF has filed multiple notifications of changes in its shareholding recently.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM10.25 billion, up 34.1% YoY and 16.2% QoQ; net profit was RM368.6 million, up 6.4% YoY and 12.5% QoQ; net margin was 3.6%, down from 3.7% a year earlier.
